findings.title: The server takes a new roll while a gilded choice is still waiting
findings.where: Backend roll handler (rolls.py), seen over the socket on main 1bc48a0; the desk blocks it in rollAction
findings.steps: Open a socket for Pontius. Send roll read with 0 drive (gilded pool 2, needs a keep). Without resolving, send roll sway with 1 Cunning.
findings.expected: FAQ line 18: the server holds the dice until a die is kept, so a second roll should be refused or wait.
findings.actual: The second roll returned a roll_result at once and the first choice was dropped. Only the desk stops it (a second tab or device that has not seen the choice could roll over it).

findings.title: Keep-a-die dice keep shimmying on touch
findings.steps: Roll a gilded action with a pool of 2 or more and look at the two dice in the tray.
findings.actual: On a mouse the shimmy stops on hover, but a finger has no hover so the dice keep moving about 3px (laptop reading when not hovered). I did not tap them on a phone to see whether a tap misses.

Nerve 0 now reads 'none' and Nerve-action rolls work for a Professor; the control could not roll them at all while a choice was waiting beside it.
Over-limit gear gives a sticky 'Over the limit of 3' by the finger on a phone.
A refused Scout use keeps the typed question and says why.
